cells.gaps: The Côte d'Ivoire Identité app holds the ID card, but the app says the authorities do not yet recognise its digital ID; ONECI's director general said in June 2025 that the card was digitised through MyONECI+ (CIV-016), without saying it is accepted as proof anywhere. A national authentication platform and wallet are only at feasibility study.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-08 under Bill's ruling of 23 October 2026 that a method counts only where the state accepts it: neither the MyONECI+ digitised card (CIV-016) nor the Côte d'Ivoire Identité app is shown accepted as proof of identity, so neither sets a rung. E-signature in use across the public administration on ANSSI's national PKI holds stage 4 (CIV-005, CIV-004, CIV-010).
